explanation: This unit tracks how late it is in the episode: it stays at 0-1 at every step through about trial 70, creeps up to 2-5 around trials 75-90, and is high (mostly 5-10) in the last 8 or so trials, where D2 is the peak step (about 10 after an a1 choice and 6-9 after a2), GO runs a bit lower (4-9) and D1 is usually lower still (2-7). In those late trials D1 jumps to about 10 on the trial when the agent is about to switch its choice, usually right after a rare transition or an unrewarded trial, and then drops back to about 3 on the next trial D1.
